pr.title: CS-283: Oxford -ize spelling throughout
pr.body:
Part of #171. Change set CS-283.

The owner chose WHO style, Oxford -ize spelling, on 2026-10-31.

- -ise and -isation become -ize and -ization: about 500 words in 248 files, for example standardized, organization, realization, authorized and immunization (PC-0033, PC-1443).
- Words where -ise is not the suffix stay as they are: enterprise, exercise, comprise, revise, practise, analyse.
- British forms such as programme and centre stay.
- URLs, link targets, block labels and the References chapter (titles of cited works) are untouched.
- One section title changes: "3.5.3 How the components are organized".

**Not in this PR**
- Fewer em-dashes (PC-0766), left for a later pass.
- Defining "Support qualifier" and "Application Interaction" before first use (PC-0033). That is new content, so it is marked Needs human on the sheet.

Released by Review Change Sets row CS-283, Ready for agent.
